about: The recorded readings build/p348/probe-p348.mjs --grader-self-test holds every grader to (docs/method/HOW-WE-BUILT-THIS.md rule 9). No run of probe:p348 existed when they were written, so each honest reading is composed in the exact shape the arm builds from main's reads, the recorders' and stand-ins' logs and this run's own capture-pane, with the Mac's words typed by hand from the tree (the self-test holds them to the probe's own readers of the tree, byte for byte). Each broken reading is the honest one with `ops` applied (set, push, delete), and answers exactly what it names: `fail` on exactly `mustFail`, or `unreadable`. Paste texts carry canaries of the run's own shape (p348c and 12 hex), which name nothing of his. THE PROBE REVIEW (2026-10-19, rule 9) added P3's and P5's control pastes, W's `pictured` and `pictureAlternate`, and renamed R2's and P6's far-log clauses to what the far log reaches; its own honest and broken readings are in fixtures/reviewer/. THE FIX ROUND (2026-10-19) added R1's Restore pressed after the Past tab was opened again (`reopened`) and P5's control made against the CURRENT picture of the question still drawn, with three broken readings of its own.
